# Bundled chart runtime

`lightweight-charts-5.0.8.js` is TradingView Lightweight Charts 5.0.8,
bundled so local charts do not require a CDN connection.

- Upstream: https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts
- Distribution: https://unpkg.com/lightweight-charts@5.0.8/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js
- SHA-256: `bcdca2a528db7c9b386918c99c544bde3eda3f0204ec2d23a64411d4cb4686c9`
- License and notice: [Apache-2.0](LICENSE-lightweight-charts.txt), [NOTICE](NOTICE-lightweight-charts.txt).

The library's TradingView attribution remains enabled in the chart.
